notes.title: A new story... FUNKYHEART
notes.notes:
Making a new funky story called FUNKYHEART!

Once again, it's been a while since Funky Panic Attack released and the support has been amazing, thank you all!

I've seen so many cool comments about FPA for a while, so I wanted to make another funky game.. Once again thank you for sharing your thoughts about the game, it is very appreciated!

I've been meaning to share this new game for a while - It is still early in development, but I figured I can show a few teasers along the way!

I'll be sharing more funky content in my [url=https://www.youtube.com/@juiccedev]Youtube[/url], [url=https://x.com/juiccedev]Twitter[/url], [url=https://bsky.app/profile/juicc.bsky.social]Bluesky[/url] and [url=https://www.instagram.com/juiccedev/?igsh=MWprcXZhYmI5Z2J0YQ%3D%3D&utm_source=qr]IG[/url]!

FUNKYHEART will have more content and secrets... It also has a bit of darker tones, but nothing too crazy.. Maybe?

You might also find some familiar faces along the way...

Also, check the announcement trailer here - I'd love to read your comments about it!

notes.title: FPA Soundtrack Release (And New Art)!
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

It's been a little while since Funky Panic Attack released, so I wanted to share some news:

The Funky Panic Attack Soundtrack is now available!! (And some new art too!)
You can listen to it on [url=https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLto3IAtVYywvSjFImjK9e0jspAG6A9cpt]YouTube with some cool visualizers[/url] that I added to the videos, OR if you like it a lot, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3080150/Funky_Panic_Attack_Soundtrack/]it's also available to buy on Steam![/url]

Plus, I wanted to share some new art of Luna!
I wonder if this is after the events of Funky Panic Attack... Somehow she looks more confident, right? Let me know what you think -

The comments and feedback for FPA have been incredibly helpful. I'll keep in mind what has been well-received and what can be improved for future projects.

As for the music, I recommend 'Industrial Code' for a chill listen, though 'voxelated' might be a more hype choice...
Also, yes, Sand Witch is a wordplay for Sandwich. Don't ask me why I did that.

Thank you so much for playing Funky Panic Attack. It's very appreciated!
I hope you enjoy the music and new art. Have an amazing week!

-juicce
